question: Under complete fresh current-policy rectangles, does the directly identity-proved positive-overkill Facet-salvage producer have robust payoff-capable natural activation, exact-inactive controls, viable activation and more than one authored Attack identity without changing path, RNG or result?
hypothesis: The current Dusk policy naturally produces authored Attack hits with strictly positive excess damage while another enemy remains often enough to support a later equal-cohort CRN first look, while a substantial exact-inactive policy set preserves causal contrast.
claimBoundary: Fresh-cohort existing-policy positive-overkill producer opportunity, payoff-capable natural capacity, exact-inactive controls, viability and card breadth only. The payoff is disabled and no causal effect, endpoint, policy control, complementarity, balance, product, acceptance or P9 claim is estimated.

scientificBasis.entryGate: The fixed source/interface/direct A/B/AB preflight completed 58 of 58 controls with zero faults and froze only positive-overkill facet-salvage-one-ember for natural capacity.
scientificBasis.observationalArm: Producer=true and consumer=false is the directly proved non-perturbing A-only instrument. It observes eligible marks, positive excess magnitude and expiry but cannot grant Ember or change policy state.
scientificBasis.capacityBoundary: Only positive-overkill marks expiring consumer-disabled while combat continues are payoff-capable. Combat-over marks are exposure evidence but cannot reach the fixed consumer.
scientificBasis.noGuessing: The complete 64-policy by four-seed rectangle, thresholds, metrics, source, identity comparator and stop rule are fixed before any whole-run row. No support-derived subset, excess threshold, magnitude level or policy control exists.

positiveOverkillPayoff.fixed: The candidate payoff is disabled in both arms. Positive overkill means exact integer excess damage greater than zero; no magnitude threshold or level is varied.

producerObservation.meaning: The candidate arm emits research telemetry for strictly positive intrinsic Facet excess-damage marks and expiry while consumer and payoff remain disabled.
producerObservation.pathConstraint: After removing positive-overkill research telemetry and probe labels, every candidate row must exactly equal its current-main pair, including policy snapshot, fights, outcome, deck, relics, economy, final RNG and all existing package metrics.

terminalHitPrecisionPayoff.fixed: Exact-lethal precision is an immutable closed family and is absent.

acquisitionPriority.fixed: Exact same sampled policy identity in each pair; no acquisition control.

design.type: Two-arm paired non-causal natural-capacity observation; not a factorial and not an endpoint experiment.

anchors.currentMain: The unmodified baseline worktree at c4130163 is the sole outcome and RNG anchor.
anchors.directIdentity: The immutable positive-overkill direct A/B/AB result d8cf8936 is the source, null, mediator and same-card payoff anchor.
anchors.closedFamilies: Archive head 843e899, exact-lethal capacity closure 6f826f60 and all earlier valid family dispositions are immutable and cannot be reopened or pooled.

design.pairing: Every arm uses policyRoot 561, policy indices 0 through 63, seeds 346630 through 346633, Duskblade, Vow 5, current content, current policy resolver, baseline, simulator and estimator in identical policy-major/seed-minor order.
mechanisticallyJustifiedInteractions: Positive-overkill producer by continuing combat: producer marks ending consumer-disabled are payoff-capable; combat-over marks are measured but cannot reach the fixed consumer.
Positive-overkill producer by authored Attack identity: card counters test whether natural capacity is broader than one card, without making card identity a level or subset.
Policy identity by simulation seed: a policy is robust-active only when payoff-capable activation occurs in at least two of its four fixed seeds.
design.aliasStructure: Final-combat positive overkills are exposure-only and do not alias payoff-capable activation. Multiple marks in one card count as one eligible card and retain mark cardinality descriptively. Excess magnitude is descriptive only and cannot create a threshold. Exact lethal is excluded because excess must be strictly positive. Scoreline, Afterimage, generic any-kill, Reaper, next-PLAY, target transfer, Shatter tempo and exact-lethal precision remain absent or closed.
design.omittedCells: No AB payoff arm, off-versus-on endpoint, policy control, excess threshold, magnitude level, card subset, seed subset, Scoreline, Afterimage, acquisition, Ward setup, protected seed, held-out row, ML, RL or optimiser.

cohort.identity: Fresh and disjoint from every frozen #421 whole-run cohort. Each of 64 deterministic policy identities is evaluated on all four seeds in both arms; no identity may be selected, removed, replaced or added.

estimands.unit: Policy identity over its complete four-seed rectangle.
estimands.exposureActive: Producer marks occur in at least two of four rows, including positive-overkill final marks.
estimands.active: At least one payoff-capable consumer-disabled positive-overkill card occurs in at least two of four rows.
estimands.exactInactive: Zero payoff-capable positive-overkill cards in all four rows.
estimands.ambiguous: Payoff-capable activation in exactly one of four rows; reported and never promoted or subsetted.
estimands.viable: An active policy has at least one payoff-capable row whose unchanged current-main outcome is win.
estimands.cardBreadth: Number and counts of distinct authored Attack ids associated with payoff-capable expiry; descriptive counts are complete and no card subset is selected.
estimands.excessMagnitude: Sum of strictly positive integer excess damage at producer marks; descriptive mechanism evidence only and never a threshold, level or selection rule.
estimands.identity: Zero canonical mismatches between each current-main row and its A-only row after removing only probe labels and positive-overkill research counters.
estimands.attribution: For every row, producer equals mediator-set; expiry partitions into eligible and combat-over cards; producer marks partition into eligible and final marks; consumer, payoff, request, realised and consumed expiry counts remain zero.
estimands.notEstimated: Payoff effect, outcome delta, excess-threshold value, policy-control value, cross-package interaction, balance, product value, acceptance or protected confirmation.

gates.provenance: The 16 active/inactive, eight viable, two-of-four robustness and one baseline-fault limits reuse the frozen 64-policy structural-capacity scale. Two eligible card identities is the smallest pre-support gate that rejects a single-card alias without selecting a card subset.

executionAndStopping.construction: Deterministic Python owns complete cohort construction, two content-addressed plans, process execution, exact paired comparison, telemetry attribution, policy aggregation and stop/go.
executionAndStopping.order: Verify immutable evidence, refs, source, Godot and ledger; pass source/cardinality gates; execute all 256 current-main rows once; execute all 256 A-only rows once; analyse the sole complete look; verify byte-identical ledger.
executionAndStopping.firstLook: All 512 observations are the only look. No source, row, policy, seed, gate, metric, threshold, subset or cap changes after execution begins.
executionAndStopping.stagedConstraint: This capacity stage may authorise only a separately preregistered equal-cohort CRN first look. It cannot support a payoff or endpoint claim.
executionAndStopping.futureCrnConstraint: Any later causal arms must use the same frozen policy identities, simulation seed identities, baseline, estimator, first-look budget and stopping rule across every compared level.
executionAndStopping.methodConstraint: No policy control, ML, RL or optimiser is authorised unless this experiment identifies a remaining repertoire bottleneck and measured decision value justifies it.

decisionRules.success: All immutable, source, exact identity, attribution and reliability gates pass; at least 16 policies are robust-active, 16 exact-inactive, eight viable, 16 exposure-active and two distinct eligible Attack ids are observed; all 512 rows complete within 120 seconds; ledger is byte-identical.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Apply boundary 1: freeze only positive-overkill facet-salvage-one-ember and preregister the smallest equal-cohort off-versus-AB CRN first look using current policy identities. Do not add a policy control, excess threshold, joint package, protected seed, ML, RL or optimiser.
decisionRules.futility: Inputs and observations complete, but any identity, attribution, reliability, active, inactive, viable, exposure or minimal card-breadth gate fails.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Apply boundary 2: close positive overkill and therefore the complete ordered terminal-hit precision/excess class without threshold, card subset, policy, cohort, payoff or method rescue; continue serially with a zero-row cross-turn-hold lifecycle design inside #421.
decisionRules.inconclusive: A frozen input or fixed process is unavailable, a process is incomplete, or the exact decision is unavailable at 120 seconds.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Apply boundary 3: record positive-overkill capacity inconclusive at the preregistered cap. Do not rerun, alter the cohort, change a gate or spend a causal/protected row.

forbidden: any causal payoff or endpoint claim from producer-only telemetry
any excess threshold, magnitude level, policy control or candidate retuning
any row, policy, seed, card, outcome or support subset
any Scoreline, Afterimage, acquisition, Ward setup or exact-lethal variation
any repair, rerun, reserve row or adaptive continuation after a completed failure
any append to the research ledger
any protected acceptance or reserve seed
